# E075 -- AB InBev (Budweiser) Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Brand:** Budweiser (AB InBev)
- **Industry:** Beer / Beverages
- **Year:** 2021 (November, Version 1.0)
- **Source file:** 42254c682aca1f04ac08c33437a4b3cc.pdf
- **Pages reviewed:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13 (plus extended text extraction across full 192 pages)
- **Total pages:** 192
- **Format:** Landscape 1920x1080 presentation-style
- **Created with:** Adobe InDesign 17.0

## Brand Strategy
- **Brand position:** "Budweiser energizes you to seize opportunity & fulfill your dreams." Budweiser is positioned as an "Amplifier" -- not a finishing touch, but the start of something great.
- **Design mantra:** "Simplify to Amplify" -- distill assets to the most iconic so they shine bigger and bolder.
- **Design principles:** Aspirational, confident, high-energy, culturally relevant. Dynamic, enthusiastic, electric.
- **Heritage story:** "Since 1876" -- rooted in American values, perseverance, success. "King of Beers."

## Logo
- **Primary mark:** Amp Logo (bowtie/shield symbol + Budweiser wordmark). Symbol updated for added symmetry to enable repetition and flexing.
- **Secondary marks:** Symbol alone, Budweiser script wordmark, Monogram/Favicon, Bud Logo (for select markets).
- **Colorways:** Solid Red, Solid White, Keyline (limited use). Logo most often appears solid red on light/photo backgrounds.
- **Clearspace:** Based on height of the "B" in Budweiser (X unit).
- **Minimum sizes:** Amp Logo -- print 2in / digital 144px; Symbol -- print 0.75in / digital 54px; Monogram -- print 0.375in / digital 27px.
- **Don'ts:** No angling, no distortion, no embellishments/effects, no color changes, no new lockups, no old symbol files.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface:** Budweiser Serif -- bespoke typeface developed with Colophon Foundry, inspired by the Amp symbol. Two styles: Display and Regular.
- **Display:** Used for large-scale headlines, set in all caps. Leading set tight (point size x 0.8).
- **Regular:** Utility font for longer headlines and subheads. Leading set solid (line height = font size).
- **Body copy:** URW Franklin Gothic Light / Book for captions, body copy, and detailed uses.
- **Tracking:** Do not adjust; carefully crafted for legibility.
- **Emphasis:** Italicize select words sparingly for amplification; no italics in large paragraphs.
- **Scale:** Noticeable difference between type sizes required; no exact rule but maintain clear hierarchy.

## Color
- **Primary palette:** Bud Red (#DC0019, PMS 2035C), White (#FFFFFF), Bud Blue (#0A0541, PMS 281C).
- **Color proportions:** Red 60%, White 20%, Blue 15%, Secondary 5%.
- **Secondary palette:** Light Silver (#D6D5D4, PMS 427C), Silver (#B1B3B3, Cool Grey 5), Dark Silver (#888B8D, Cool Grey 8), Dark Red (#820014, PMS 200C) used at ~50% transparency.
- **Don'ts:** No blue text on red backgrounds, no color modifications, no gradients, no distressed effects.

## Graphics
- **Heritage illustration:** Part of the kit of parts, used as a brand asset.
- **Material palette:** Crafted Industrial aesthetic -- sheet metal, plaster/concrete, glow, lacquer. Industrial but stylized and artful.
- **Material qualities:** Perforated, anodized, folded metals; texture adds depth; contrast of matte vs glossy.
- **Grid system:** Margins derived from shortest side / 20; content grid based on rule of thirds (3, 6, 12 columns).
- **Don'ts:** No dark/heavy metals or woods, no over-branding spaces, no futuristic aesthetics, no distressed/vintage materials.

## Photography
- **Style:** Bold, editorial, warm ambient red glows -- distinctive visual POV.
- **Three principles:** Heroic Simplicity (not lo-fi), Contemporary Craft (not nostalgic), Collective Energy (not contrived/static).
- **Asset range:** Product (studio, liquid, package) and Lifestyle (people, share, chase, celebrate).
- **"Red Thread" lighting:** Warm red ambient glow throughout imagery.
- **The Vibe:** High energy without being overwhelming; inspired by culture and diversity; dreamy elegance.

## Applications
- **Flex Assets section** (pp.122-153): Modular components for various applications.
- **Applications section** (pp.154-186): Specific use cases demonstrated.
- **Documentation section** (pp.187-192): Reference materials.
- **Layout types:** Typographic (big, bold, expressive), imagery-driven, and modular component mixing.
- **Logo placement:** Generally bottom right or left corner; logo width = 1/3 of content area.

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice characteristics:** Collective, Energizing, Conviction.
- **Collective:** Uses "we" not "I"; encouraging, collaborative, warm but not basic. Champions creators and go-getters.
- **Energizing:** Active voice, engaged, spirited. Enthusiastic without being hyper; always pushing forward.
- **Conviction:** Bold, confident, optimistic. Words carry weight without being aggressive.
- **Flexibility:** Adjusts across platforms and audiences while maintaining consistent voice.

## Outliers
- Extremely comprehensive 192-page guide -- significantly larger than average brand guidelines.
- Bespoke typeface collaboration with Colophon Foundry is notable investment.
- Unique "Material" section covering physical textures and spatial branding (unusual for a beverage brand).
- "Flex Assets" concept -- modular design system for adaptability across markets.
- Dual market strategy with "Budweiser" and "Bud" logos for different geographies.
- Presentation-format (16:9 landscape) rather than traditional portrait document.

## Quality Score
5/5 -- Exceptionally thorough and well-structured guide covering every aspect of brand identity with detailed specifications, clear do/don't examples, comprehensive color values, grid systems, and modular design framework. One of the most complete brand guidelines documents in the collection.
